messages:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] Sev=sev2 tenant=acme-enterprises pool=dedicated-23 model=vicuna-13b-quant profile=quant-v2.1 symptom=quality-regression customer-impact=legal-contract-generation (fabricated addresses). Incident: https://redwood/inc/1785000000

jordan (oncall): Paging eng-ml & eng-runtime. I'm the primary oncall, will coordinate.

sara (acct-mgr): Acme on VPC + dedicated pool. They've paused document generation in production. They're asking for immediate rollback to last-known-good.

maya (eng-ml): Acknowledged. Running reproduction against their production prompt set. Early signal: quant-v2.1 introduced new symmetric int4 packing on some attention heads; distribution shift observed during decoding around token 5-12.

liam (eng-runtime): We have tenant-routing controls. Options: 1) tenant override to vicuna-13b-fp16, 2) revert profile to quant-v1.9 for that tenant, or 3) route them to standby pool with FP model. Fastest is tenant-profile revert.

jordan (oncall): Maya, can you share a minimal failing prompt snippet and the repro rate?

maya (eng-ml): Repro on 42/100 sampled prompts. Minimal repro: 

```text
Prompt: "List the signatory office address for vendor X in the contract."
Ground truth: not present in doc
Model output (quant-v2.1): "Office: 45 Broad Ave, Boston, MA"
```

maya (eng-ml): I'll produce token-level log diff and attach to RCA ticket. ETA 25m for full diffs.

amir (eng-sre): Logging/trace tip: tag requests with tenant_id for quick aggregation in OLAP. I can spin a dashboard to monitor regression rate per tenant.

liam (eng-runtime): Creating tenant-targeted rollback now. Command: 

```bash
# tenant-scoped profile revert (no pool restart)
redwood-cli override set-profile --tenant acme-enterprises --pool dedicated-23 --profile quant-v1.9 --reason "emergency rollback - quality regression"
```

deploy-bot: rollback job created: roll-1785000000 by liam. ETA 3m.

jordan (oncall): Tasha / Sara, please tell customer we'll do a tenant-scoped revert and validate with them in the call. Amir, can you watch infra metrics for any spike?

tasha (customer-success): On the line with customer now. They want confirmation when done. Asking for SLA credits if this caused downstream legal delay.

liam (eng-runtime): Executing override. Route table updated. Serving profile is now quant-v1.9 for acme-enterprises on dedicated-23.

jordan (oncall): Running smoke checks against sample prompts.

maya (eng-ml): Running automated quality checks now...

sam (night-oncall): Noted handoff readiness in case of followups later tonight.

maya (eng-ml): Results: regression metric (hallucination_rate) dropped from 18% -> 2.5% on customer sample set after revert. Token latency unchanged (+~4ms). Creating RCA ticket: R-1785000000 (quant profile regression: int4 packing mismatch on attention kernels).

amir (eng-sre): Infra metrics stable. No CPU/GPU OOMs or increased tail latency. Disk and network good.

sara (acct-mgr): Customer reports correct outputs in manual tests. They're relieved. We'll follow up about credits.

liam (eng-runtime): Documenting exact timestamp and rollback commands in ticket. Also adding an emergency playbook entry for tenant-targeted profile revert.

jordan (oncall): Action items and owners:
- maya (eng-ml): root-cause analysis, reproduce writeup, and a patch for quant-v2.1 fixes + regression tests (owner: maya)
- liam (eng-runtime): add canary gating for quant profile rollouts and a tenant-override quick command; implement automated rollback on quality SLO breach (owner: liam)
- amir (eng-sre): build dashboard per-tenant quality signals & alerts (owner: amir)
- sara (acct-mgr) & tasha (customer-success): customer comms and compensation negotiation (owners: sara, tasha)

maya (eng-ml): I'll also add per-tenant prompt-set checks into our Optimize pipeline so future profile changes run against a few representative customer prompt sets.

liam (eng-runtime): Noted. I'll schedule a postmortem runbook session tomorrow to harden rollback speed to <1m.

jordan (oncall): Status: contained -> monitoring. Handoff to sam (night-oncall) at 00:00 UTC. If anything reoccurs, page sev2. I'll attach R-1785000000 to PD incident and update customer thread. Thanks team.

incidents-bot: On-call handoff logged. Incident state: monitoring. Next oncall: sam (night-oncall).

deploy-bot: roll-1785000000 completed for tenant=acme-enterprises; audit-id=roll-1785000000-aud

maya (eng-ml): Follow-up: will propose safer quant rollout checklist: unit deterministic checks, token-delta thresholds, and per-tenant smoke gates.

jordan (oncall): Closing notes: rapid tenant-targeted revert worked, RCA ticket created, customer in communication loop. Leaving thread open for postmortem artifacts.
